items.title: Myna | Product
items.snippet:
Myna | Product
[...]
Get searchable meeting memory to make virtual meetings actually useful. With Myna, if you’re in the meeting you’re the host.
[...]
Stop making notes. Start meeting with Myna - video replays, transcripts and audio of your virtual meetings. With Myna you’re always the host, so you’re always in control. Get exactly what you need out of your calls.
[...]
Even if you’re not the host, take control of your recording of the meeting. Myna can start meetings automatically.
[...]
searchable direct from
[...]
Teams and Zoom meetings are recorded automagically.
[...]
Record directly from your own desktop. Remember, you’re always the host so you have all the privileges and permissions to do what you need to.
[...]
#### Meet the Myna recording app
[...]
If you’re a Windows 10 user, you can capture any meeting.
[...]
- Integrates with GSuite/Office365 Calendar
- Auto-start/stop selected meetings
- Record by meeting type or calendar label
[...]
It’s so easy to use and connect to your existing tech, but if you need help we’re here to give it.

items.title: Features — Myna Private Call Recorder
items.snippet:
Features — Myna Private Call Recorder
[...]
Myna watches your running processes and browser tabs for meeting activity. When it detects a call, it can start recording automatically — no manual intervention needed.
[...]
Project deadline extended to Friday 21st. The team agreed to prioritise the API integration before moving to front-end polish.
[...]
Generate meeting summaries and action items using Ollama, running locally on your machine. Because Myna records dual-channel audio with speaker labels, the AI knows who said what — and who committed to what.
[...]
No cloud AI. No API keys
[...]
No subscriptions to third-party services. Install Ollama, pick a model, and Myna handles the rest.
[...]
Connect Google Calendar or Microsoft 365 to see upcoming meetings in Myna's dashboard. Recordings are automatically tagged with the meeting title and attendees.
[...]
in your system tray
[...]
a recording starts
[...]
Every component of Myna was designed from the ground up to work without a network connection. Here is what that means in practice.
[...]
never uploaded anywhere
[...]
Transcription and AI run
[...]
on your hardware.
[...]
Once installed, Myna works fully offline. Record, transcribe, and summarise without a connection.
